text.title: PWA Core Architecture Worked Example
text.summary: One worked end-to-end example showing a PWA Core Architecture artefact filled from a realistic input bundle. Trace runs from input brief → evidence gathering → schema fill → validator pass → review surfacing. Then the implementation patterns: Workbox service worker, registration module, and install prompt hook patterns.
